specimens.name: oros-zero
lessons: Oros identity, Blueprint capability identity, Talos execution capability and Block identity are distinct layers.
A disposable proving Oros should stay deliberately tiny and non-product.
Explicit Block resolution can stand in for a future resolver without inventing registry authority.
Visual boundaries must not pretend to be executable plan steps.

specimens.name: oros-image-prep-transplant
lessons: Second consumer uses canonical source rather than a copy.
Transplant/browser proof is evidence toward reuse maturity.

specimens.name: oros-affiliate-offer-transplant
lessons: Second consumer proof exists and is already cited by V2 admission evidence.

specimens.name: office-buddy-mini
lessons: Small extension Oroi remain useful as Factory dogfood and Level-3 composition examples.
Minimal-permission MV3 extension is a valid small-application archetype.

specimens.name: eu-capitals-travel-log
lessons: Local-first searchable/filterable progress tracker is a reusable app composition archetype; product content itself is not a Block.

specimens.name: factory probes
lessons: Factory probes are proof fixtures, not products or reusable capability.
